description: A React component for a modal dialog allowing users to confirm leaving a team, with different messages based on user role and channel membership.

classes.name: LeaveTeamModal
classes.description: A React component representing a modal dialog for leaving a team, handling user interactions and displaying context-sensitive messages.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with show set to true.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds keypress event listener when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes keypress event listener when component unmounts.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show to false.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles keypress events, submits form if Enter key is pressed.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Performs leave team action and toggles sidebar, then hides modal.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with context-sensitive message and action buttons.
